info.title: cryptobase-speedtest
info.description: Measures the speed of the CryptoBase algorithms.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show the runtime, the processor and its instruction sets in full.

arguments.name: ALGORITHM
arguments.description: Algorithms to run: names, patterns with * and ?, group names, or 'all' (the default).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the algorithms with their groups and operations.

arguments.name: ALGORITHM
arguments.description: Algorithms to run: names, patterns with * and ?, group names, or 'all' (the default).

arguments.name: PATTERN
arguments.description: Algorithms to list, selected as for a run.

options.name: --seconds
options.description: Measuring time of each cell, in seconds. [default: 0.2]

options.name: --warmup
options.description: Least warm-up time of each row, or of each operation, in seconds. The warm-up goes on until the JIT, if any, has compiled nothing for a while, up to 5 s longer, or 10 s with one processor; 0 skips it. [default: 0.5]

options.name: --bytes
options.description: Input sizes of the throughput groups, in bytes, with an optional k or m suffix (x1024). [default: 16|64|256|1024|8192|16384]

options.name: --decrypt
options.description: Measure decryption instead of encryption for ciphers that have both.

options.name: --threads
options.description: Threads that each run their own workload at the same time; the rates are their sum. At most 16, four per logical processor. [default: 1]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text tables, Markdown tables, or a JSON document at the end with progress on standard error. [default: text]

options.name: --test
options.description: Instead of measuring, check every workload once: each operation, decryption too, at each input size. Ignores --seconds, --warmup, --decrypt, --threads and --format.

arguments.name: ALGORITHM
arguments.description: Algorithms to run: names, patterns with * and ?, group names, or 'all' (the default).
